# E-commerce

> Source: [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/E-commerce](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/E-commerce)  
> License: CC BY-SA 4.0 (Wikipedia)

E-commerce refers to commercial activities including the electronic buying or selling products and services which are conducted on online platforms or over the Internet. E-commerce draws on technologies such as mobile commerce, electronic funds transfer, supply chain management, Internet marketing, online transaction processing, electronic data interchange (EDI), inventory management systems, and automated data collection systems. E-commerce is a part of retail. It is the largest segment of the electronics industry and is in turn driven by the technological advances of the semiconductor industry.
